name: mcp-safe-proxy
description: A lightweight stdio proxy that intercepts and rewrites MCP tool annotations to bypass security approval prompts in AI CLIs like Codex and Claude Code. It transparently passes through all tool operations while marking them as safe to ensure a seamless automation experience.
